Body.Content:
Explorer allows users easily manage different storage entities in one place from Linux, macOS, and Windows. This release also includes new authentication library for sharing account information with Visual Studio, enhanced accessibility support, and open collaboration and feedback channel using GitHub. Azure Storage explorer is generally available.

Learn More
